title: Entrance
description: Things lurking on the periphery of people's lives lead to horrific conclusions.

description: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

title: The Twin
description: What begins as a time of healing in the quiet Scandinavian countryside soon takes an ominous turn when a woman begins to unravel the torturous truth about her son and confronts the malicious forces that are trying to take hold of him.
